## Publication Information

**Date:** 1861

**Imprint:** London: SPCK

**Notes:** The same author also published <i>The story of David and Jonathan : a Sunday book</i> by G. F. L., author of The missing sovereign, etc., etc. (London: Hatchard 1865).   He or she was a friend of Susanna Warren.
